title: Standardized Blood Pressure Measurement Protocol
implementation_guidance: Implement standardized blood pressure measurement protocol; ensure patient is seated comfortably with back supported and feet flat on floor for 5 minutes before measurement; position arm at heart level with palm facing up; use appropriately sized cuff (bladder encircling 80% of arm); take at least 2 readings 1-2 minutes apart and average results; document which arm was used and position; avoid measuring after caffeine, exercise, or full bladder; train all staff on proper technique; consider implementing automated office blood pressure measurement when available.
expected_outcomes: Improved accuracy of blood pressure readings, reduced misdiagnosis of hypertension, better-informed treatment decisions, enhanced identification of white coat and masked hypertension, improved blood pressure control rates, reduced unnecessary medication adjustments.
target_population: All Medicaid-enrolled adults requiring blood pressure assessment, particularly those with diagnosed or suspected hypertension.
citation: Carey RM, Wright JT Jr, Taler SJ, Whelton PK. Guideline-driven management of hypertension: an evidence-based update. Circ Res. 2021;128(7):827-846. doi:10.1161/CIRCRESAHA.121.318083
